name: Elena
source:
A nun dressed in a sister’s habit

She worships Vestina, the sole deity of Kyndia. Calm, compassionate, and with a saintly demeanor, she serves as a support figure during the protagonists' journey.
Etina is a master of healing magic, capable of instantly mending any wound.
Although she typically stays in the background offering support, she transforms into a ferocious fighter when enraged or drunk, wielding brass knuckles hidden in her habit to decimate monsters. Her strength in these moments is so overwhelming that even orcs, twice the size of an average human, flee in terror.
As a child, she often found herself surrounded by collapsed individuals, prompting her to become a nun to maintain self-discipline.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228054440/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.kitsuneisekaicol]Google Play[/url]]
